enum AppError
  MissingInput
  BadInput(value: Text)
end

fn parse() -> Result<Int, ParseError>
  return ok(1)
end

fn load() -> Result<Int, AppError>
  return parse().map_error(problem => match problem
    ParseError.Empty => return AppError.MissingInput
    ParseError.Invalid(value) => return AppError.BadInput(value)
  end)
end
